question: With the upstream on another machine, what did the proxy cost per request?
answer_hinglish:
Do-host run (X2) mein upstream alag machine par tha, toh woh proxy ka CPU nahi baant raha tha. 32 connections par direct 6616 req/s aur proxy ke through 2844 req/s mile: lagbhag 43 percent. Ek machine par yeh lagbhag 24 percent tha, kyunki wahan upstream bhi usi CPU par tha. Direct ka number ek machine se kam hai kyunki ab har request network par jaati hai.

Asli 'per request' cost ek connection wali runs se dikhta hai, jahan koi queue nahi hoti: direct 1996 req/s, proxy ke through 1042 req/s. Har request ka samay 1000/rate hai, toh proxy ne har request mein lagbhag 0.46 ms joda. Network ka round trip (TCP connect) p50 0.7 ms tha (X1). Matlab is setup mein proxy ka apna kaam ek network round trip ke barabar ka hai.

Request log band karne par phir faayda: 3264 vs 2844 req/s. Caveat: CPU steal 5.86 percent tha, ek hi run set, aur load generator aur proxy ab bhi ek hi 2-core machine par the.
why_needed: Proxy ko kab rakhna hai, iske liye per-request cost ka andaza chahiye.
real_world_analogy: Beech ka ek checkpoint: har gaadi ko thoda rukna padta hai, jitna ek chhota signal.
how_it_works: Ek connection par rate ka ulta = har request ka samay. Do rates ka farak = proxy ka joda hua samay.
disadvantages: Generator aur proxy ek machine par
common_mistakes: Ek machine wale number ko do-host par laagu karna
follow_up_questions: Proxy ko kahan rakhoge taaki network hop kam ho?

question: On another machine, a dead port can fail in three different ways. What did each one look like?
answer_hinglish:
X4 ne teen alag ports par ek-ek koshish ki, pehle seedha TCP se (proxy ke bina), phir proxy ke through (retries off, connect timeout 2000 ms).

(1) Jis port ko A1 ka firewall REJECT karta hai: raw TCP ko `EHOSTUNREACH` mila 2.3 ms mein (ICMP 'host prohibited'), proxy ne `EHOSTUNREACH` record kiya aur client ko 502 diya. (2) Jo port firewall mein khula hai lekin us par koi sun nahi raha: raw TCP ko `ECONNREFUSED` (1 ms, kernel ka RST), proxy ka 502 aur `ECONNREFUSED`. (3) Jo port cloud network ke rules mein allowed hi nahi: packets chup chaap drop, koi jawab nahi: raw TCP 3500.8 ms tak intezaar karke `TIMEOUT`, aur proxy ne 2013 ms par 504 diya (`ConnectTimeoutError`).

Seekh: pehle do jaldi fail hote hain (milliseconds), teesra timeout tak latakta hai. Isliye connect timeout itna important hai: wahi tay karta hai ki silent drop kitna mehenga hai. Aur teeno error codes proxy ki retry list mein hain, toh GET doosre upstream par chali jaati (yahan retries band the taaki har failure saaf dikhe). Pehle maine EHOSTUNREACH ko sirf firewall rules padh ke predict kiya tha; is run ne usse confirm kiya.
why_needed: Network failures ke alag symptoms pehchanna debugging aur timeouts ke liye zaroori hai.
real_world_analogy: Darwaza khatkhatana: 'andar aana mana hai' (reject), 'koi ghar par nahi' (refused), ya ghanti ki awaaz hi nahi (drop).
how_it_works: REJECT: ICMP error turant. Refused: TCP RST turant. Drop: kuch nahi, timeout.
code_example:
port the host firewall REJECTs: raw EHOSTUNREACH in 2.3 ms, proxy 502 (EHOSTUNREACH)
port open in the firewall, nothing listening: raw ECONNREFUSED in 1 ms, proxy 502 (ECONNREFUSED)
port the cloud network silently drops: raw TIMEOUT in 3500.8 ms, proxy 504 (ConnectTimeoutError)
advantages: Prediction ko data se check kiya
common_mistakes: Connect timeout ko bahut lamba rakhna
follow_up_questions: Silent drop ko jaldi kaise pakdoge?
ICMP block ho toh REJECT kaisa dikhega?

advanced.architecture_tradeoffs: Firewall ko REJECT par rakhna clients ko jaldi fail karne deta hai (achhi UX, kam timeout bojh); DROP scanners se chhupata hai par har galat client ko timeout tak latakata hai.
advanced.failure_scenarios: Cloud rule hatne par saara traffic silent drop: har request connect timeout tak latakti hai jab tak passive ejection na ho.
advanced.alternatives: Active health checks se drop wale upstream ko pehle hi hata dena; connect timeout chhota rakhna.
advanced.scale_10x_100x: Zyada traffic par silent drop zyada connections ko ek saath latakata hai; ejection ki speed ahem.
advanced.production_improvements: Error code ka metric (EHOSTUNREACH vs ECONNREFUSED vs timeout), aur connect timeout ko RTT se tune karna.

question: How do you make a temporary change to shared cloud network rules without breaking anything?
answer_hinglish:
Do-host run ke liye Oracle ke security list mein ek rule jodna tha, jo teeno servers share karte hain, aur jiske peeche A1 par ek doosri application chalti hai. Khatra: `update_security_list` poori list ko REPLACE karta hai; ek galat call SSH, 80 aur 443 ke rules mita sakti hai.

Tareeka jo apnaya: (1) ek chhota tool (`deployment/scripts/oci_seclist_rule.py`) jo poori list padhta hai, sirf EK tagged rule jodta ya hatata hai, pehle dry run mein farak dikhata hai, likhne se pehle poori list ka backup leta hai (repo ke bahar), aur likhne ke baad dobara padh ke check karta hai ki baaki sab rules waise ke waise hain. (2) Rule sabse narrow: sirf A2 ka private address (/32), sirf chaar test ports, aur ek tag taaki hatana exact ho. (3) A1 par pehle snapshot (firewall rules, listening ports, containers), ant mein usse diff: identical. (4) Har kadam ke baad SSH, port 80 aur naam se HTTPS check. (5) Rule lagbhag 7 minute hi khula raha.

Galtiyan jo hui aur unse seekha: mere tool ki verification ek baar crash hui (egress rules ko galat key se compare kiya) jab write ho chuka tha; maine backup se haath se verify kiya, bug fix kiya, aur removal automatic verification ke saath chala. Aur `pkill -f` ne apne hi shell ko maar diya kyunki pattern uske command line mein bhi tha; baaki cleanup exact commands se kiya. Dono baatein deployment doc mein likhi hain.
why_needed: Shared infrastructure ki galti doosron ki service gira sakti hai.
real_world_analogy: Shared building mein electrician: sirf apna circuit, pehle photo, kaam ke baad sab switch dobara check.
how_it_works: Read-modify-write with backup, narrow tagged change, before/after snapshot, aur har kadam ke baad health check.
code_example:
python oci_seclist_rule.py add --cidr <A2_PRIVATE_IP>/32 --ports 18001-18004 --tag h11-bench-temp          # dry run
python oci_seclist_rule.py add --cidr <A2_PRIVATE_IP>/32 --ports 18001-18004 --tag h11-bench-temp --apply
python oci_seclist_rule.py remove --tag h11-bench-temp --apply
disadvantages: Tool ka verification bug ek baar crash hua
common_mistakes: Poori list ko bina padhe replace karna
pkill -f se apna hi shell maar dena
follow_up_questions: Isse Terraform jaise tool mein kaise karoge?
Change window aur rollback plan kaise likhoge?

advanced.architecture_tradeoffs: Haath se script vs infrastructure-as-code: script jaldi aur chhoti, IaC reviewable aur repeatable par setup lagta hai.
advanced.failure_scenarios: Galat replace se SSH lockout; rule hatana bhool jaana; tool ka verification fail hona.
advanced.alternatives: Terraform ya OCI Resource Manager, alag staging VCN, network security groups sirf test VMs par.
advanced.scale_10x_100x: Bade setup mein har network change code review aur automated plan/apply se.
advanced.production_improvements: IaC, change log, automatic expiry wala rule, aur alerting agar temporary rule ek ghante se zyada rahe.
